description: An overhead hanging core exercise emphasizing lower abdominals, hip flexor control, and grip endurance.
setup: Hang from an overhead pull up bar with overhand grip and legs straight down beneath hips.
steps: Depress shoulders slightly and brace abdomen to eliminate body swing.
Flex hips and curl knees smoothly upward toward chest until thighs break 90 degrees.
Pause momentarily at peak contraction, then lower legs with slow control back to straight hang.
cues: Roll pelvis upward toward ribs rather than just swinging legs
Keep ribs pinned down and control the descent

mistakes.mistake: Using momentum and swinging wildly from the shoulders
mistakes.fix: Reset completely at the bottom of each rep, keeping lats active

mistakes.mistake: Arching lower back sharply as legs descend
mistakes.fix: Maintain slight hollow body tension in abdominals even at dead bottom

rep_standard: Knees rise above hip height at top, legs return to dead hang without swinging
